star_check.counts: i_0=1, i_1=m+1, i_j=binom(m,j) for 2<=j<=m; zero thereafter.
star_check.first_descent: For m>=4, Delta_0 and Delta_1 are positive; subsequent binomial differences first become negative at ceil(m/2), with Delta_m=-1.
star_check.selector_and_sum: Every leaf qualifies since m<2p+2. Every tagged summand binom(m-1,p)-binom(m-1,p-1) is negative since m<2p. Hence S=m times that term is negative.

primary_assessment: Open: neither the star subfamily nor the corrected first-mark identities establish the complete arbitrary-tree aggregate; no full-sum counterexample is supplied.
